name: Thunder Lance · Arcane
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand straight to the aim point, striking everyone along the line, then chains on from the last one. In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 10.75 ❤ lightning + 3 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 252: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 4.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.75 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
